messages:
Maria PM: Quick design sync — trying a compact credentials surface (side panel instead of full drawer) for create/rotate/revoke flows. Dropped in a prototype. Thoughts on affordance density and warning hierarchy?

Jon (UX): I like side panel for quick create. Saves vertical space in dashboard. Concern: does it feel crowded when we show permissions chips + rotation history?

Sam (Eng): From infra side panel reduces route effort. But we need explicit API to fetch granular perms for many keys — batching could help. Also watch token reveal security: don't send full secret in HTML until user clicks.

Lee (Design): Mock: https://figma.com/... (uploaded). Key points: compact row shows label, last-used, three-dot menu. Expand inline to show actions: rotate, revoke, copy. Rotation modal in-panel to avoid context switch.

Ada (a11y): A11y nits: ensure focus trap inside side panel, `role=dialog`, aria-labelledby uses key label. On rotate success, announce `Announcement: Key rotated` and move focus to success toast. Undo must be reachable via keyboard.

Jon (UX): Copy nits: keep warning tone for revoke but not alarmist: "Revoke will stop services using this key immediately." Instead of "Destroy". Add inline hint: "Need to rotate? create a replacement first."

Sam (Eng): Revoke soft-delete: propose 24h soft-delete window with undo toast. Implementation: background job marks key as revoked but keeps it readable for 24h. Need product ok on security policy.

Maria PM: Product: soft-delete is fine for self-serve; for orgs with strict policy we should offer "Immediate permanent revoke" toggle. Default to soft with clear label + countdown.

Lee (Design): UI: we show "Undo" in toast and a small skeleton in list: blurred row with `revoked — undo` affordance. If user navigates away, show banner in console with link to `Recover keys`.

Ada (a11y): Screenreader: for blurred row use `aria-disabled=\"true\"` and `aria-live=\"polite\"` on the toast. For copy button, mark `aria-label=\"Copy secret to clipboard. Shows secret only for 10 seconds.\"` Also ensure clipboard announcement.

Jon (UX): Permissions chip: compact chips with tooltip on hover. Keyboard: pressing Enter on chip opens granular role picker. Need focus styles high contrast.

Sam (Eng): Backend: role picker should support pagination and fuzzy search. For large orgs retrieving role matrix per key could be expensive — cache per session.

Maria PM: Empty state: when no keys, propose CTA "Create API key" plus microcopy: "Keys are used for server-to-server calls. Not for end-user tokens." Also link to rotation best practices.

Lee (Design): Minimal alt layout: when user has >50 keys, switch to density mode — collapse last-used and show badges only. Toggle in top-right to "Compact mode".

Jon (UX): Concern: discoverability of "Compact mode" — show a brief onboarding tooltip when first enabled.

Ada (a11y): Keyboard nav across rows: arrow keys move between rows, Enter opens actions menu. For screen readers provide `aria-rowindex` and visible focus ring.

design-bot: Screenshot uploaded: sidepanel_v3.png :thumbsup:

Maria PM: Next steps: Lee to update figma with soft-delete states + focus order. Ada to write accessibility checklist. Sam to confirm backend feasibility and perf budgets. I'll schedule follow-up next Tue.

Lee (Design): Will update by EOD. Quick question — timeline for rollout? Maybe feature flag + gradual rollout.

Sam (Eng): Feature flag + canary 5% then 25%. I'll add telemetry to measure clicks on rotate/revoke and undo rates.

Jon (UX): I'll draft microcopy variations A/B for revoke tone. Share PR in #product-docs.

Ada (a11y): I'll add screenreader test steps and include expected `aria-live` strings.

Maria PM: Awesome, thanks everyone :rocket:
